name: HKHPL
description: Segmentation of handwritten Kannada text on historical palm leaf manuscripts to evaluate manuscript text segmentation approaches.
reputation: Niche, language- and domain-specific benchmark with limited adoption outside South Asian cultural-heritage document analysis research.
notes: Small, domain-specific dataset (Kannada palm-leaf manuscripts); non-LLM, variable preservation/ink quality and severe class imbalance; segmentation metrics depend on annotation granularity (pixel vs. region).
